scripts.build: openapi-typescript openapi.json --default-non-nullable false --check -o src/schema.generated.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: openapi-typescript openapi.json --default-non-nullable false --check -o src/schema.generated.ts && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: openapi-typescript openapi.json --default-non-nullable false --check -o src/schema.generated.ts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
